prompt: The mnemonic "Grandma Always Visits London In May For Winston's Party" gives which group of amino acids?
choices: The nonpolar ones — G, A, V, L, I, M, F, W, P
The polar ones — S, T, C, N, Q, Y
The charged ones — D, E, K, R, H
explanation: Its initials are the one-letter codes for the 9 NONPOLAR residues: Glycine (G), Alanine (A), Valine (V), Leucine (L), Isoleucine (I), Methionine (M), Phenylalanine (F), Tryptophan (W), Proline (P).
teach: Three phrases cover all twenty: nonpolar "Grandma Always Visits London In May For Winston's Party" (9), polar "Santa's Team Crafts New Quilts Yearly" (6), charged "Dragons Eat Knights Riding Horses" (5).
